text: Mercenaries and auxiliaries are useless and dangerous; and if one holds his state based on these arms, he will stand neither firm nor safe; for they are disunited, ambitious, and without discipline, unfaithful, valiant before friends, cowardly before enemies; they have neither the fear of God nor fidelity to men, and destruction is deferred only so long as the attack is; for in peace one is robbed by them, and in war by the enemy.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
locator: Chapter XII, How many kinds of soldiery there are and concerning mercenaries
location: Sant'Andrea in Percussina, near Florence, Italy
